## Hypothesis

The strategy attempts to capture scalping edges through tight profit targets (75% premium gain), tight stops (35% premium loss), and short time stops (12 minutes), combined with a volume filter (vol_ratio_threshold=1.2) and OTM strike selection (strike_offset=2). The edge exists in exploiting short-term mean reversion or momentum bursts in high-volume 0DTE options, but the approach risks overfitting to non-J days due to poor alignment with J's anchor day structure.

## Mechanism

- **Entry:** Trigger when volume ratio exceeds 1.2 (current bar volume / 20-bar average volume) and strike is OTM by 2 strikes (strike_offset=2).  
- **Exit:**  
  - Profit target: Exit 66.7% of position at 75% premium gain (tp_premium_pct=0.75).  
  - Stop loss: Exit entire position at 35% premium loss (stop_premium_pct=-0.35) or after 12 minutes (time_stop_min=12), whichever occurs first.  
  - Profit-lock: Chandelier-style profit lock arms at 60% premium gain (chandelier_arm_pct=0.6) and trails 15% off high-water mark.  
  - Time stop: Hard exit at 12 minutes if no other exit triggered.
